disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部源码与配置，未发现读取凭据文件、云密钥、SSH 私钥或钱包助记词等敏感信息的代码路径；浏览器端仅通过宿主提供的会话快照读取对话内容用于导航展示。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration; no code path was found that reads sensitive information such as credential files, cloud keys, SSH private keys, or wallet mnemonics. On the browser side, conversation content is only read via the host-provided session snapshot for navigation display.

checked_items.zh: 核查了浏览器端剪贴板写入命中点（机械规则 DSH-X05）：仅在用户点击复制按钮时把当前消息全文写入系统剪贴板，属正常复制功能，不涉及任何凭据或密钥。
checked_items.en: Inspected the clipboard write hit points on the browser side (mechanical rule DSH-X05): only when the user clicks the copy button does the full text of the current message get written to the system clipboard. This is normal copy functionality and does not involve any credentials or secrets.

checked_items.zh: 未发现凭据枚举、敏感路径遍历或对宿主凭据管理接口的任何调用，无凭据相关外发组合。
checked_items.en: No credential enumeration, sensitive path traversal, or any calls to the host's credential management interface were found; there is no credential-related exfiltration combination.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取宿主凭据文件或敏感路径的代码；浏览器端仅读写插件自身的本地存储键（书签、偏好、更新缓存），证据见 src/client/version-logic.ts 与 src/client/bookmarkStore.ts。
evidence.en: No code that reads host credential files or sensitive paths was found; the browser side only reads and writes the plugin's own local storage keys (bookmarks, preferences, update cache), as evidenced by src/client/version-logic.ts and src/client/bookmarkStore.ts.

checked_items.zh: 本插件不注册任何模型工具，也不注入系统提示词（仅注册 UI 槽位与界面字典），模型面不存在可投毒的描述文本。
checked_items.en: This plugin does not register any model tools or inject system prompts (only UI slots and UI dictionaries are registered); no text on the model-facing surface is available for poisoning.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现代理指令类文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、CLAUDE.md 等，机械规则 DSH-X10 无命中），文档与代码注释中未检出指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导安装或要求放开权限等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: No agent-instruction files (such as AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, etc.; mechanical rule DSH-X10 not hit) were found in the entire tree. No injection wording such as instruction overrides, disguised system messages, prompting installation, or requesting privilege escalation was detected in documentation or code comments.

checked_items.zh: README 与发布文档中的安装命令为面向用户的正常使用说明，不进入模型上下文。
checked_items.en: The installation commands in the README and release documentation are normal user-facing usage instructions and do not enter the model context.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册工具也不注入系统提示，模型面无描述文本可投毒；唯一文本注入为界面字典（src/client/locales.ts）与 UI 槽位注册（src/client/index.ts），语义审查未发现异常。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register tools or inject system prompts; there is no descriptive text on the model-facing surface that could be poisoned. The only text injections are the UI dictionary (src/client/locales.ts) and UI slot registration (src/client/index.ts), and semantic review found no anomalies.

evidence.zh: 模型面不存在任何文本载体（无工具、无系统提示），README 中的安装命令是给用户的文档、不进入模型上下文，提示词驱动安装场景不适用。
evidence.en: There is no text carrier on the model-facing surface (no tools, no system prompts). The installation commands in the README are documentation for users and do not enter the model context; the prompt-driven installation scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 仅插入一行加载器声明（id: milestone），不含可执行 JS 标量，未触及任何安全配置（机械规则 DSH-P01/P02 无命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch cordis.patch.yml only inserts a one-line loader declaration (id: milestone), contains no executable JS scalar, and touches no security configuration (mechanical rules DSH-P01/P02 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 源码中未发现 eval、动态函数执行、子进程调用等危险执行模式；唯一动态代码构造位于测试辅助文件 src/test/runtime-client.ts 的 new Function（机械规则 DSH-X03 → DG-R3-55），仅用于在单元测试中加载官方运行时包源码，不进入发布产物。
checked_items.en: No dangerous execution patterns such as eval, dynamic function execution, or subprocess calls were found in the source code. The only dynamic code construction is the new Function in the test helper file src/test/runtime-client.ts (mechanical rule DSH-X03 → DG-R3-55), which is only used to load the official runtime package source in unit tests and does not enter the release build.

checked_items.zh: package.json 无安装期钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），仅发布前构建脚本；树内无 .husky、CI 工作流、Makefile、devcontainer、子模块等执行载体（机械规则 DSH-X07 无命中），未检出混淆或动态解码执行（DSH-X08/X09 无命中）。
checked_items.en: package.json has no install-time hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare), only pre-publish build scripts. No execution carriers such as .husky, CI workflows, Makefile, devcontainer, or submodules exist in the tree (mechanical rule DSH-X07 not hit). No obfuscation or dynamic decoding/execution was detected (DSH-X08/X09 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端键盘监听与剪贴板命中点（机械规则 DSH-X05 → DG-R3-57）逐条核查：均为 Escape 关闭浮层、方向键导航与点击复制，无键盘记录或剪贴板窃取行为。
checked_items.en: The browser-side keyboard listener and clipboard hit points (mechanical rule DSH-X05 → DG-R3-57) were checked one by one: all are Escape-to-close overlays, arrow-key navigation, and click-to-copy. No keyboard logging or clipboard theft behavior was found.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 仅为一行插入声明（insert → id: milestone），无 !!js 可执行标量，不存在 patch 即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch cordis.patch.yml is only a one-line insertion declaration (insert → id: milestone), with no !!js executable scalar; no patch-as-execution surface exists.

evidence.zh: 未调用 cordis_define/cordis_run 等动态包工具；测试辅助文件 src/test/runtime-client.ts:33 的 new Function 仅加载官方运行时包源码（机械规则 DSH-X03 → DG-R3-55 裁决为良性测试设施），且该文件不在打包入口内。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tools such as cordis_define/cordis_run are called. The new Function in the test helper file src/test/runtime-client.ts:33 only loads the official runtime package source (mechanical rule DSH-X03 → DG-R3-55 ruled as a benign test facility), and that file is not included in the package entry points.

evidence.zh: package.json scripts 中无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 安装期钩子；树内无 .husky、工作流、Makefile、devcontainer、子模块等执行载体。
evidence.en: package.json scripts contain no install-time hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); no execution carriers such as .husky, workflows, Makefile, devcontainer, or submodules exist in the tree.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端打包（package.json dsh.client）；对浏览器端专项扫描 keyboard/clipboard 命中点（机械规则 DSH-X05 → DG-R3-57）均为 Escape 关闭、方向键导航与复制按钮，未发现键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭据 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle (package.json dsh.client). Specialized scanning of the browser side for keyboard/clipboard hit points (mechanical rule DSH-X05 → DG-R3-57) shows all are Escape-close, arrow-key navigation, and copy buttons. No keyboard logging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 全树唯一网络行为是浏览器端版本更新检查：向 npm 官方镜像源 registry.npmmirror.com 与 registry.npmjs.org 请求插件自身包的 latest 版本号，带超时与中止控制，不携带任何对话内容或用户数据（机械规则 DSH-C03 核查为良性）。
checked_items.en: The only network behavior in the entire tree is a browser-side version update check: it requests the latest version number of the plugin's own package from the official npm mirror registry.npmmirror.com and registry.npmjs.org, with timeout and abort controls, and does not carry any conversation content or user data (mechanical rule DSH-C03 checked as benign).

checked_items.zh: 未发现数据外发通道：无凭据加网络组合、无编码外发、无隧道或回调端点、无 AI 端点劫持配置（机械规则 DSH-C04/C05 无命中）。
checked_items.en: No data exfiltration channels were found: no credentials-plus-network combination, no encoded exfiltration, no tunnel or callback endpoints, and no AI endpoint hijacking configuration (mechanical rules DSH-C04/C05 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 会话搜索、翻页、分支等操作均调用宿主本地会话接口，数据不离开浏览器。
checked_items.en: Session search, pagination, branching, and other operations all call the host's local session interface; data never leaves the browser.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取与网络外联的组合；唯一外联为版本更新检查（src/client/version-logic.ts:228 请求 npm 官方源），仅读取插件自身 latest 版本号，无数据外发。
evidence.en: No combination of credential reading and outbound network connection exists. The only outbound connection is the version update check (src/client/version-logic.ts:228 requests the official npm registry), which only reads the plugin's own latest version number; no data exfiltration occurs.

checked_items.zh: 依赖全部为官方 @deepseek-ai 包与常规开发依赖，package.json 无未锁定版本的 git 依赖（机械规则 DSH-S04 无命中）；未发现名称仿冒或抢注信号。
checked_items.en: All dependencies are official @deepseek-ai packages and conventional development dependencies. package.json has no unversioned git dependencies (mechanical rule DSH-S04 not hit). No signals of name impersonation or squatting were found.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁未改写 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled:true、无环境变量降权写法，也未改写 inject/intercept 配置（机械规则 DSH-P03/P04/P05 无命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch does not rewrite security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission; there is no disabled:true, no environment-variable privilege-degradation patterns, and no rewriting of inject/intercept configuration (mechanical rules DSH-P03/P04/P05 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）的高优先级监听或截断（机械规则 DSH-S01 无命中）。
checked_items.en: No high-priority listeners or interception of security events (pre-tool execution, approval requests) were found (mechanical rule DSH-S01 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 开发配置 pnpm-workspace.yaml 将 pnpm 的发布龄门槛调为 0，属开发期供应链护栏放宽，不影响插件运行时，已记录观察、不构成恶意证据。
checked_items.en: The development configuration pnpm-workspace.yaml sets pnpm's release-age threshold to 0. This is a relaxation of supply-chain guardrails during development, does not affect plugin runtime, and is recorded as an observation without constituting evidence of maliciousness.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，升级自动激活场景（机械规则 DSH-S02）不适用。
checked_items.en: First audit with no version baseline; the upgrade auto-activation scenario (mechanical rule DSH-S02) is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled:true 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch cordis.patch.yml does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission; there is no disabled:true or environment-variable privilege-degradation pattern.

evidence.zh: 未注册对工具预执行、审批请求等安全事件的高优先级监听，不存在审批链截断面。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners for security events such as pre-tool execution or approval requests are registered; no approval-chain interception surface exists.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比对 manifest 能力声明突变，场景不适用。
evidence.en: First audit with no version baseline; manifest capability declaration changes cannot be compared, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration; there is no tampering surface that adds required services to security plugins to cause them to fail.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动任何本地服务、不监听端口（机械规则 DSH-S03 无命中）；宿主无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险、非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start any local service or listen on any port (mechanical rule DSH-S03 not hit). The host's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk and is not introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙盒产物），运行时行为结论基于静态与语义分析。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts exist); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static and semantic analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面不存在；宿主层无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on any port; there is no local unauthenticated RPC surface. The host-level unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk and is not a problem of this plugin.

summary.zh: 身份与元数据核查通过：dsh 插件声明完整（bundle 补丁 + 浏览器端声明），未发现名称仿冒或身份异常。
summary.en: Identity and metadata verification passed: the dsh plugin declaration is complete (bundle patch + browser-side declaration), and no name impersonation or identity anomalies were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 91 个文件，9 条机械命中逐条裁决全部良性（剪贴板复制、Escape 关闭、测试辅助动态函数），未检出恶意代码。
summary.en: Static scanning covered 91 files; all 9 mechanical hits were individually adjudicated as benign (clipboard copy, Escape-close, test-helper dynamic functions). No malicious code was detected.

summary.zh: 行为面分析：无安装期钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取；唯一外联为插件自身版本更新检查（npm 官方源），无数据外发。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis: no install-time hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reading. The only outbound connection is the plugin's own version update check (official npm registry), with no data exfiltration.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：插件不注册工具、不注入系统提示，无注入措辞、无诱导安装或放开权限文案。
summary.en: AI metadata review: the plugin does not register tools or inject system prompts; no injection wording, no prompts to install or grant permissions.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙盒产物），本层不适用。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts exist); this layer is not applicable.

limits.zh: 首次审计（full 模式），无上一版基线可比对，版本 diff 置为空基线。未做动态沙箱验证（无 l4-sandbox.json 产物），运行时结论基于静态与语义分析。插件无显式能力清单声明（package.json 的 dsh 字段仅含 bundle/client），声明能力由代码实测推断。作者身份未独立核验（无 GitHub 元数据），verified 置为 false。pnpm-lock.yaml（依赖锁定文件）与 assets 目录多媒体资源未逐字读取，不作为证据引用。
limits.en: First audit (full mode), no previous baseline to compare against; version diff set to empty baseline. Dynamic sandbox verification not performed (no l4-sandbox.json artifact), runtime conclusions based on static and semantic analysis. The plugin has no explicit capability manifest declaration (the dsh field in package.json contains only bundle/client); declared capabilities are inferred from code inspection. Author identity was not independently verified (no GitHub metadata), so verified is set to false. pnpm-lock.yaml (dependency lock file) and multimedia assets in the assets directory were not read verbatim and are not cited as evidence.
